stories.title: 5 commercial banks listed as top 7 FX market traders
stories.summary: SEOUL, Aug. 26 (Yonhap) -- Five local commercial banks were among the top seven ...
article_sentences: Five local commercial banks were among the top seven institutions in foreign exchange trading over the past year, a market operator said Wednesday.
In spot trading, Kookmin Bank, Shinhan Bank, Woori Bank, Hana Bank, NH Nonghyup Bank, state-run Korea Development Bank (KDB) and Credit Agricole of France made the list.
Kookmin Bank, Shinhan Bank, Woori Bank, Hana Bank, JPMorgan Chase, Standard Chartered Korea and HSBC Korea were the top seven institutions in foreign exchange swap trading.

The committee, a public-private voluntary body managing and operating the country's foreign exchange market, has released the list since last year to facilitate competition in the local foreign exchange market and promote sound market practices.
